# Local Perks

> A yearly membership that unlocks exclusive local deals at cafes, kids activities, restaurants, family days out, everyday essentials and getaways. Members show a digital member card or a one-off voucher code at the counter.

## Key pages
- /: Home — what the membership is and how it works
- /deals: Deals directory with category, suburb and map views
- /join: Become a member
- /gift: Gift a membership to family or friends
- /business: For local businesses — list a deal for members
